explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/555: R_k(G) is the least m such that every k-colouring of E(K_m) contains a monochromatic G; determine R_k(C_{2n}). EdgeColoring is a symmetric map Fin m → Fin m → Fin k (diagonal values are irrelevant, since the embedding is injective and EvenCycleAdj is irreflexive for n ≥ 2). ContainsMonochromaticCopy is an injective map sending all cycle edges to one colour. IsEvenCycleRamseyNumber is IsLeast of the admissible m. The value question asks for a function giving R_k(C_{2n}) for all k ≥ 1, n ≥ 2. Faithful.
